answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Work waits on the quartz until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the timber of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the saffron of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
